policy.text:
version: 1
operations:
  refund:
    level: Execute within Limits
    max_amount_minor: 500
    approval_above_minor: 200
    currency: USD
    retry: never
  accept_claim:
    level: Execute within Limits
    max_amount_minor: 500
    approval_above_minor: 200
    currency: USD
    retry: never
  provide_evidence:
    level: Execute within Limits
    retry: safe
  make_offer:
    level: Execute within Limits
    max_amount_minor: 900
    approval_above_minor: 500
    currency: USD
    retry: never
  send_message:
    level: Execute within Limits
    retry: safe
  propose_resolution:
    level: Draft
    retry: never
caps:
  per_customer_per_day_minor: 900
egress:
  allow_hosts:
    - api-m.sandbox.paypal.com
policy.owner_rule: Settle an item that has not arrived on its own up to USD 5.00. Ask me from USD 5.01 up to USD 9.00. Never more. Send evidence when the records answer the claim. Every other dispute reason goes to me untouched.
